Based solely on data quality, assign a single numeric score to this figure.

Scoring rules:
- The score must be an integer between 0 and 100 (inclusive).
- 100 represents the highest data quality.
- A score of 85 or above is considered excellent.
- A score below 60 is considered failing.

Respond with one number only.
Do not include any words, symbols, or explanations.
